contexts.text: The terraqueous globe... is a kind of base and support; for it is the ultimate work...
Of the terraqueous globe, regarded in itself, are predicated the things of space; and of its rotation and progression, are predicated those of time.
Things at rest, of which the terraqueous globe consists.
At last... the terraqueous globe... was formed of earths... TCR 78:4.
When the universal firmament together with the terraqueous globe is expected to perish.
